description: This PHP class defines the LDAPSetting data transfer object (DTO) for configuring LDAP authentication within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for LDAP server configuration, bind settings, user lookup, data mapping, and synchronization intervals. The class supports serialization/deserialization to/from JSON, validation, and encapsulates LDAP configuration logic.

classes.name: LDAPSetting
classes.description: Data transfer object for LDAP configuration settings, including server details, bind authentication, user lookup configurations, data mapping, and synchronization preferences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LDAPSetting with core server configuration parameters.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an LDAPSetting instance from a JSON string, decoding stored configuration.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the LDAPSetting instance into a JSON string for storage or transmission.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns LDAP server hostname.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets LDAP server hostname.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns LDAP server port.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets LDAP server port.

methods.name: getEncryption
methods.description: Returns encryption type used for LDAP communication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Validates and sets encryption type (none, tls, ssl).

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns LDAP implementation type (e.g., OpenLDAP).

methods.name: setImplementation
methods.description: Validates and sets LDAP implementation type.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: isOptReferrals
methods.description: Returns whether LDAP client options referrals is enabled.

methods.name: setOptReferrals
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP referral options.

methods.name: isBindAnonymously
methods.description: Returns whether anonymous bind is used.

methods.name: setBindAnonymously
methods.description: Configures whether to bind anonymously.

methods.name: getBindUserDN
methods.description: Returns the Distinguished Name for bind user.

methods.name: setBindUserDN
methods.description: Sets the bind user's DN.

methods.name: getBindUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the password used for bind authentication.

methods.name: setBindUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the bind user password.

methods.name: isEnable
methods.description: Returns whether LDAP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP authentication.

methods.name: shouldMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Indicates if LDAP users should be merged with existing system users.

methods.name: setMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Configures merging LDAP users with existing users.

methods.name: getSyncInterval
methods.description: Returns LDAP sync interval in hours.

methods.name: setSyncInterval
methods.description: Sets LDAP sync interval.

methods.name: getDataMapping
methods.description: Returns the data mapping configuration object.

methods.name: getUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Returns array of LDAP user lookup settings.

methods.name: addUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Adds a user lookup setting to the configuration.
